messages:
incident-bot: Pager: auth-service high error rate (P1 candidate) — unusual TLS handshake fails + 401 bursts. Paging oncall: sophie
sophie (oncall): ack — looking now
dan: seeing 401 spike from a small set of client IP ranges + a burst of GET errors to /token/issue from the same hosts
leila: fwiw our logs show a recent deploy with DEBUG=1 in auth-service. I'm grepping for tokens — I can see what looks like session tokens in plaintext in the debug lines.
mike-qa: confirmed from curl against /health some upstream 502s then 401s depending on header ordering
sophie (oncall): ok, initial assessment: leaked tokens in logs (probable dev flag), suspicious traffic hitting token endpoint -> risk of token replay. Customers: 3 support tickets reporting login failures in last 10m. Set severity P1 and start mitigations.
sec-eng: immediate actions: 1) block the offending IP ranges at cloud firewall/WAF 2) disable debug flag 3) rotate service tokens/keys 4) redact logs and start audit for exfil.
leila: disabling DEBUG on prod auth now: ```kubectl -n prod set env deployment/auth DEBUG=false && kubectl rollout status deployment/auth``` -> rollout started, pods cycling
dan: applying quick WAF rule to block the high-volume IP CIDRs: ```aws wafv2 update-web-acl --name prod-waf --scope REGIONAL --rules '[{"Name":"block-suspicious","Priority":1,"Action":{"Block":{}},"Statement":{"IPSetReferenceStatement":{"ARN":"arn:aws:wafv2:...:ipset/suspected"}}}]'``` -> patching in progress
sec-eng: also adding a rate-limit rule on /token/issue and /session/create to mitigate replay attempts.
mike-qa: I'm tailing auth logs; after rollout I still see some 401/400 churn but debug lines are gone. Need to rotate any tokens that might have been printed.
leila: enumerating which token families got logged. Looks like: svc-ingest service account token and a small number of user session tokens from a debug path. Starting rotation for svc-ingest now.
sophie (oncall): rotation plan: generate new KMS key version, create new svc token, deploy env change pointing service to new token, then revoke old token. Keep old keys for 1 hour to catch any in-flight jobs. Notify CS after rotation.
dan: created new key material in KMS (kms-key-rot-177821) and minted new svc token. Deploying new secret to prod secret store: ```vault kv put secret/prod/svc-ingest token=***``` then triggering pods to pick up new secret via rolling restart.
leila: redaction step: running log-redact job to strip tokens from the last 4 hours of logs in CloudWatch and S3. Command: ```python tools/log_redact.py --prefix prod/auth --pattern "(Bearer|token)\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-_.]+" --rewrite```. Starting now — may take ~15m.
sec-eng: we need to confirm no external S3 buckets received those logs. I've scanned recent s3 PUTs and nothing unusual. Still running deeper DLP scan on outbound flows.
mike-qa: post-rotation smoke: auth ingest uses new token, requests succeed and 401s decrease to baseline. Affected customer retries succeed with new tokens.
sophie (oncall): customer impact draft for CS: "We observed an authentication disruption caused by a debug flag which caused tokens to be logged. We blocked suspicious traffic, disabled debug logging, rotated affected service tokens, and redacted exposed logs. No evidence of external exfiltration so far. We're continuing monitoring and will rotate any additional keys if we find more exposures." Can someone draft a concise bulletin? @leila
leila: drafting now. cc @ajay for next oncall handoff.
dan: leaving temporary WAF blocks in place for 2 hours; adding a whitelisting rule for known partners so we don't block legitimate traffic.
sec-eng: recommend a follow-up checklist for postmortem: 1) audit why DEBUG=1 made it to prod 2) add CI check to forbid printing of tokens in logs 3) reduce default log verbosity for auth 4) automate log redaction on ingest 5) rotate service tokens quarterly.
sophie (oncall): creating the incident ticket and attaching timeline + logs. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-incident (see section: tokens-in-logs).
incident-bot: Incident labelled P1 — created incident/2026-03-15-auth-token-exposure, paging escalation sent to sec-eng and oncall rotation.
ajay: ack — I'm taking over for the next shift. summary received, will own monitoring and customer comms for next 4h. setting a metric alert at 0.5% error for /token endpoints and a 2xx ratio check.
mike-qa: smoke pass looks good. I'll keep tails for 30m then hand off to ajay.
leila: handing off findings to ajay: tokens printed by a legacy debug path when request header X-Debug=1 was present on certain clients. Need to remove the header acceptance or require auth for debug endpoints.
ajay: noted. will schedule a quick config change to remove header acceptance and follow postmortem checklist. thanks team.
sophie (oncall): great work — thanks everyone. closing active mitigations but leaving WAF blocks for monitoring window. will update incident ticket with timeline and customer note once leila finalizes draft. :white_check_mark:
